a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the 8-cell plan will probably end before either of us reaches 4 cells. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us now. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can agree on something new. I won't take anything without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. If we get through round 1, the reserve should reach 6, and we keep going to 8. Then we take 4 each.
